args.query: Musk super PAC contributions FEC individual contributions 2026

sql: SELECT c.committee_name, SUM(i.amount) AS total, COUNT(*) n, MIN(i.transaction_date) d0, MAX(i.transaction_date) d1 FROM fec.individual_contributions i LEFT JOIN fec.committees c ON c.committee_id=i.committee_id AND c.year=2026 WHERE i.year=2026 AND i.contributor_name ILIKE 'MUSK, ELON%' AND i.amount>=100000 GROUP BY c.committee_name ORDER BY total DESC
SELECT year, SUM(amount) AS total, COUNT(*) n FROM fec.individual_contributions WHERE year IN (2024,2025) AND contributor_name ILIKE 'MUSK, ELON%' AND (memo_cd IS NULL OR memo_cd<>'X') GROUP BY year
